After looking at your last chart, it made me doubt whether the trade at FO area is worth taking.

These are my thoughts:

1. If we know that is FO area, I believe it is better to wait a little
more at the actual FL or MPL as taking the trade at FO area most
probably decrease RR.

2. Taking this trade is only good as increasing entry opportunities.
Entry 1 at FO area and Entry 2 at MPL and S/L still beyond FL they are
reacting to.
